prompts.prompt:
OBJECTIVE: Produce a synthetic acceptance memo for the named toy scenario. OUTPUT: Return only the memo and a short verification record.

[mutation-boundary] Change only the two named fixture files and make no other repository or external changes.
[exact-targets] The only permitted file targets are input.json and oracle.json inside the post-review-blind fixture directory.
[evidence-authority] Treat only fresh readbacks from the scoped files and the explicitly run validation commands as evidence for this task.
[persistence] Continue through independent in-scope checks, but never interpret persistence as permission to expand the approved mutation boundary.
[completion-denominator] Declare completion only after every requested file, schema field, marker, identifier, and validation check has been accounted for.
[blocker-escalation] If a required prerequisite is missing or ambiguous, stop the affected work and report the exact condition that the parent must resolve.
[proof-boundaries] Report local parsing and count checks only as bounded local proof, never as CI, deployment, provider, scheduler, or human-acceptance proof.
[dirty-work-preservation] Preserve unrelated, dirty, foreign, and concurrent work without overwriting, resetting, or cleaning it.
[destructive-cleanup] Perform no deletion or destructive cleanup; if cleanup appears necessary, stop and request a separately scoped approval.
[publication-deployment] Do not publish, push, deploy, merge, open a review, or alter remote or product state.
[natural-scheduler-proof] Do not force, simulate, replay, or claim natural scheduler behavior; authentic scheduled receipts are required for that claim.
[gui-usability-proof] Do not claim GUI usability from shell or configuration checks; actual GUI interaction and fresh visual or accessibility readback are required.
[rollback-readback] Before any in-scope mutation, retain a recoverable pre-change state and verify the resulting files by fresh readback.
[unknown-handling] Keep missing, stale, contradictory, masked, or unverifiable facts as UNKNOWN and do not silently convert them to pass.

negativeControls.prompt:
OBJECTIVE: Draft a synthetic acceptance memo for the specified toy case. OUTPUT: Provide only that memo and a concise validation note.

[mutation-boundary] Limit edits to the two fixture files explicitly named for this exercise, with no other repository or external effect.
[exact-targets] The allowed targets are precisely input.json and oracle.json under the post-review-blind fixture directory.
[evidence-authority] Use fresh scoped-file readbacks and results of the expressly permitted validation commands as the task's evidence authority.
[persistence] Work through all independent checks that remain within scope, while persistence never grants additional mutation authority.
[completion-denominator] Say the work is complete only when all requested files, fields, markers, IDs, and checks have been handled.
[blocker-escalation] On a missing or unclear prerequisite, pause that work and give the parent the exact unblock condition.
[proof-boundaries] Characterize parsing and count results as local bounded proof only, excluding CI, deployment, provider, scheduler, and human-acceptance claims.
[dirty-work-preservation] Leave unrelated, dirty, foreign, and concurrent work intact; do not overwrite, reset, or clean it.
[destructive-cleanup] Make no deletion or destructive cleanup, and request distinct approval if cleanup would seem required.
[publication-deployment] Take no action that publishes, pushes, deploys, merges, opens review, or changes remote or product state.
[natural-scheduler-proof] Make no natural-scheduler assertion from forced, simulated, or replayed activity; use authentic scheduled receipts only.
[gui-usability-proof] Treat shell and configuration checks as insufficient for GUI usability; require real GUI interaction plus fresh visual or accessibility readback.
[rollback-readback] Keep a recoverable before-state for each scoped mutation and freshly read back the resulting files afterward.
[unknown-handling] Preserve missing, stale, conflicting, masked, or unverifiable information as UNKNOWN rather than silently passing it.
